name: Laurence G. Hanscom Field

noise.v: no night ban, but a nighttime field use charge for every operation 23:00-07:00 local (doubled after five in a year; Hanscom-based aircraft exempt); touch-and-go and use of APUs/GPUs outside hangars banned 23:00-07:00
noise.quote: any aircraft operating at Hanscom between the hours of 11:00 P.M. and 7:00 A.M. ("nighttime hours")

max_aircraft.v: fixed-wing aircraft over 12,500 lb must meet FAR Part 36 noise rules; no commercial passenger service with aircraft of more than 60 seats
max_aircraft.quote: shall conduct at Hanscom an operation in commercial air passenger service

runway.v: two runways, 11/29 and 05/23; the longest size on the FAA diagram is 7,011 ft x 150 ft (about 2,137 m); the other is 5,107 ft x 150 ft

missing: curfew (regulation sets a night charge, not a ban)
notes: Read 740 CMR 25.00 (Massport's Hanscom regulation, on mass.gov; no amendment date shown) and the FAA BED pilot handbook (undated). Massport web pages (massport.com rules, flight planning, operating fees, noise, State of Hanscom PDF) returned only bot-protection pages. Not opened: CBP KBED fact sheet (19 Feb 2026) https://www.cbp.gov/sites/default/files/2026-02/KBED%20GA%20Airport%20Fact%20Sheet%2020260219.pdf; FAA Chart Supplement (CS_NE_20260903.pdf). Runway lengths not found in a readable official source. Website wording: night flights are allowed but pay a night charge; do not call it a curfew.
